title: Delete Device
name: DeleteDeviceById
description:

If there are Observations associated with that Device, it can't be deleted to preserve the observation history. Instead, it is set in dismissed status. The dismissed status cannot be reverted.

title: Get all Devices
name: GetDevice
description:
Returns a paginated list of all Devices. Protected by access token.
Pagination settings (skip/limit) and field filters in the URL request, e.g. GET /devices?skip=10&limit=50&name=deviceCrs4
To filter/search by device type you need the device type id from /deviceTypes API and then filter by deviceTypeId field.
To filter/search by thing you need the thing id from /things API and then filter by thingId field.
To filter/search by device _id (one or more), simply set the URL parameter 'devices', which can be a comma separated list or array of ids, e.g. GET /devices?devices=12345,54321, GET /devices?devices=12345&devices=54321

Header.description: Unique access token. If set, the same access_token in body or in URL parameter must be undefined

examples.title: Header-Example:

Query Parameter.description: Access token that grants access to this resource. It must be sent in body or as URL parameter If set, the same token sent in Authorization header must be undefined
Filter by device name. It can be a string (e.g. name=Crs4Dev), a string array (e.g. name=Crs4Dev&name=dev2&name=dev3) or a list of comma separated strings (e.g. name=dev1,dev2,dev3)

Filter by device description. It can be a string (e.g. description=Crs4Dev), a string array (e.g. description=desc1&description=desc2&description=desc3) or a list of comma separated strings (e.g. description=desc1,desc2,desc3)
Filter by device status (e.g. disabled=true)
Filter by device type. To get device type identifier look at /deviceTypes API
Filter by thing . To get thing identifier look at /things API
Pagination skip parameter - skips the first n results
Pagination limit parameter - limits results total size to n
Pagination totalCount parameter. If true, in _metadata field totalCount parameter contains the total number of returned objects
Ordering parameter - orders results by ascending values
Ordering parameter - orders results by descending values
A list of comma separated field names to project in query results

examples.title: Request-Example:
examples.content: HTTP/1.1 GET /devices?name=dev1_Crs4 dev2_Crs4&field=name,description&access_token=yJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJtb2RlIjoidXNlciIsImlzcyI6IjU4YTMwNTcxM

Success 200.description: Number of results of this query skipped
Limits the number of results returned by this query
If specified in the request, it contains the total number of query results; it is false otherwise
A paginated array list of device objects
